description: This file contains composable UI components for background rendering in an Android Jetpack Compose project. It defines a main background (`NiaBackground`) and a gradient background (`NiaGradientBackground`) with theming support, as well as preview annotations for light and dark themes.

methods.name: NiaBackground
methods.description: Main background component using Surface, applying background color and tonal elevation, with content slot.

methods.name: NiaGradientBackground
methods.description: Gradient background with custom gradient colors, using drawWithCache to render angled gradients.

methods.name: BackgroundDefault
methods.description: Preview composable for the default background in light and dark themes.

methods.name: BackgroundDynamic
methods.description: Preview composable with dynamic theming enabled.

methods.name: BackgroundAndroid
methods.description: Preview composable with Android theme enabled.

methods.name: GradientBackgroundDefault
methods.description: Preview composable for the default gradient background.

methods.name: GradientBackgroundDynamic
methods.description: Preview composable for gradient background with dynamic theming.

methods.name: GradientBackgroundAndroid
methods.description: Preview composable for gradient background with Android theme.
